# admin-3 — مدير النظام: التصدير والصيانة والتوزيع والسجل والحوارات (A08–A12)

- 2026-09-17 restart check: `git status --short` shows no uncommitted file under src/Wakeel.Admin*, tests/Wakeel.Admin.Tests or docs/build/progress/admin-3.md, so the cut-off first attempt left nothing behind and this is a clean start from admin-2's accepted tree. Read B1 §A rows A08–A12, ARCHITECTURE §4 `.wakeel-setup` paragraph, DATA-MODEL §13 (`setup_exports`, `pending_changes`, `audit_log` already in 0001_admin.sql), admin-2's progress and the public API of AdminKeyService/AdminDeviceKeyService/AdminDeviceService/AdminOrgService/AdminStructureService/AdminPendingChanges/AdminAuditService and Wakeel.Crypto Setup + Containers.
- step 1 ✅ export services: `Services/Export/SetupExportService.cs` (plan → write → record), `AdminGuidePdf` + `PdfFontFile` + `ArabicShaping` (a one-page provisional guide written by the tool itself, with the product's Arabic face embedded and joined into its presentation forms so the page reads right to left), `IAdminFileDialog` seam with a do-nothing default, `Services/Maintenance/MaintenanceService.cs`, `Services/Distribution/DistributionService.cs`, `Services/Audit/AdminAuditQuery.cs`, `Text/AdminAr.Export|Maintenance|Distribution|Audit.cs`, registration through `AddAdminExport()`. One change inside admin-2's code: a device certificate now names its office by the structure node's id instead of the `offices` row's id — the setup format carries `office.unitId` and `SetupChecker` refuses a file whose certificate names anything else, so every exported file would have failed the reader's own office check (admin-2's assertion updated with the reason). Build green.
- step 2 ✅ `AdminExportTests` (13 facts) — every one reads the written file back through `SetupPackageReader`, the reader the first run uses: all checks held with and without the four attachments, the letter template and the guide really travel, the seed leaves with the first file and the device is given fresh keys for a second one, `setup_exports` and the log record it with no password in either, the file name is `<office>-<device>-<date>.wakeel-setup`, a revoked device and an office with no key are refused, a password this product did not issue is refused before the seed is touched, the signed revocation list travels once a device is shut out, and the guide's every character has a glyph in the shipped face. The generated PDF was opened and looked at (Edge over CDP, 1000×1300): title, organisation, rule, four steps and date all read correctly right-to-left — two things the picture showed and fixed: the guillemets were pointing the wrong way (« » now mirror like every other pair) and the rule ran through the organisation's name (moved into the gap).
- step 3 ✅ A08 «تصدير ملف الإعداد»: WStepper over four steps (المكتب والجهاز ← المحتوى ← كلمة مرور الملف ← الحفظ) with a summary rail that stands beside every step; step 2 is two WTables (يُضمَّن دائمًا / مرفقات اختيارية with a WCheckbox and a size per attachment), step 3 shows the generated password once with a copy button, a red WBanner and the «حفظت كلمة المرور» checkbox that unlocks step 4, step 4 writes the file and offers «حفظ نسخة…» and «فتح المجلد» through the new IAdminFileDialog. Route added to AdminRoutes.Built with A09/A10/A11.
- step 4 ✅ A09 «الصيانة»: opening a folder / a backup / a message through the file chooser, the findings and the contents of what was opened as two WTables, account recovery behind a red button and the typed AdminConfirmDialog, and «آخر أعمال الصيانة» read back from the log. A10 «توزيع التحديثات»: the waiting changes (what, kind, who it reaches, how long, state), the affected offices (devices, changes pending, last export, ready/blocked with the reason in a tooltip), the batch behind the typed danger dialog, and the produced files with a password each, a «نسخ الجدول» button and the way to the folder. A11 «سجل العمليات»: WSearch + WTable (متى / الوصف / من / ماذا as a toned WChip) with paging, a row count footer and a CSV export through the chooser. Build green.
- step 5 ✅ A12 «حالات وحوارات المدير» at /states: the five moments drawn in the page with WDialog's inline shape (AdminConfirmDialog gained an `Inline` pass-through), so the sheet and the real dialogs are one component — إلغاء جهاز (typed, red), تغيير صيغة الترقيم (typed, red), ملف تالف/كلمة مرور خاطئة, نجاح التصدير, شعار كبير جدًا. The Windows host gained `WpfAdminFileDialog` (save as / open / choose folder / show in file window) registered before AddWakeelAdmin so the do-nothing default stays only in a test host.
- step 6 ✅ tests: `AdminMaintenanceTests` (15 facts — a backup and a message written by Wakeel.Crypto's own writer with the administrator's copy of the content key are opened, checked and listed; a stray file, a missing one and a damaged one are each refused in their own words; a folder is counted with its sound and its damaged files; recovering an account re-issues the keys and writes a file; every opening reaches the log; distribution reaches only the office a device change belongs to and every office when the structure changed, gives each file its own password that opens that file and no other, and says why a revoked device got none; the log search folds alef and taa marbuta, the CSV carries the four columns of the screen with no token and no secret, quotes every field and disarms a line that starts with `=`) and `AdminExportScreenTests` (16 facts over A08–A12). admin-1's `A03_SwitchesOffTheWaysOutThisBuildDoesNotCarryYet` became `A03_OpensTheWaysOutNowThatTheScreensBehindThemExist`: both dashboard ways out are live now that A08 and A11 exist, which is this package's «enable the A03 header actions». 218/218 green, three builds 0 warnings.
